# Questions · BRL-3he3

## q-6htbvp0 · open · blocking · by Boyd

Which domain name should the public server use?

One name serves the game (UDP 5000), the HTTPS token endpoint, `/healthz`, and the privacy and account-deletion pages (BRL-z277, BRL-71r3, BRL-tysh). It's baked into release clients as the default server, so changing it later means a client update. You need to own it (or a subdomain of a domain you own) and be able to create A records with a short TTL.

- [ ] A subdomain of a domain you already own

  For example `play.<your-domain>`. Give the exact name.

- [ ] Register a new domain for the game

  For example `pewpewblitz.<tld>`. Give the name you register.
